Can we get a seller-enablement intro and a short joint-account planning call next week? Proposed attendees from our side: myself, Karthik (partnerships), Ben (sales lead). From AWS: marketplace seller enablement + their Solutions Architect.

Proposed times (PST): Tue 2028-07-03 10:00-11:00 / Wed 2028-07-04 08:00-09:00 / Thu 2028-07-05 09:00-10:00.

Thanks — appreciate a quick thumbs up on availability.
